maria_k: Quick heads-up — onboarding flow in the Python quickstart is currently broken for async users. Two issues: the async sample uses `async with Client(...)` but our async client no longer implements the context manager, and the README still calls `generate()` while the SDK now exposes `create()` (users hit AttributeError). Also the auth guide link in the README 404s: https://docs.redwood.com/python/auth

cheng_li: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the minimal repro?

maria_k: Sure — here's what a new user runs (copy/paste from README):
```python
from redwood import Client

async def main():
    async with Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY") as c:
        res = await c.generate("hello world")
        print(res.text)
```
Error they see: `TypeError: object async context manager must have __aenter__` and then `AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'generate'` in some combos.

sam_j: Right — we changed the async init pattern (we use `await Client.create()` to return an async-ready client) and renamed `generate` -> `create` in v0.9.0. Looks like the quickstart landed partially updated.

amanda_docs: Sorry — that was my merge. I updated the sync example but missed the async section and a couple links. I'll open a patch. Will also add a redirect for the old auth URL.

maria_k: Thanks. Two quick asks: can we add a tiny CI smoke test that runs the quickstart snippet (sync + async) so this doesn't regress? And can the patch include the exact working snippet so community folks copying it succeed immediately?

sam_j: Agreed on CI test. Suggest we run the snippet in a lightweight container in docs CI (no GPU) with `pytest -k quickstart` that validates output shape/keys.

amanda_docs: I'll draft a fix. Proposed async snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
import asyncio

async def main():
    client = await Client.create(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
    res = await client.create(prompt="hello world")
    print(res.choices[0].text)
    await client.aclose()

asyncio.run(main())
```
I'll also replace the bad link with the canonical: https://docs.redwood.com/python/overview#auth and add a small note about env var vs explicit key.

doc-bot: Created INF-487: "quickstart: async snippet + auth link fix" assigned to amanda_docs (priority: P3). See https://tickets.redwood.internal/INF-487 :thumbsup:

cheng_li: Can we also add a short changelog note in the docs about `generate -> create` renaming? Community questions keep hitting support.

amanda_docs: Yep, adding a "Migration: v0.8 -> v0.9" blurb and example mapping. Will link to SDK release notes.

maria_k: Awesome. Once patched, drop the PR link here and I'll queue the CI smoke job. :rocket:

sam_j: FYI tagging eng-runtime in the PR for confirmation that `Client.create()` is the recommended async surface going forward.

amanda_docs: Will do.

maria_k: Thanks everyone — caught early, should be an easy fix. :sparkles:
